answer: I would anchor trust in Licensed bell ringer record with bell ringers association attestation. With peals the association recorded across years of towers, a single knoll check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. Each account presents its proof once, the network verifies it in seconds, and a farm that wants ten accounts must pass ten independent checks — the prism is that the work cannot be shared or replayed. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The sparrow grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
